title: InformationNode
description: One ingested public-info item (a person, news item, song, or image) turned into a dense machine-facing UNDERSTANDING. Stage-A artifact: read by the MAP/LINK stage and the GENERATE stage but contains NO derivative creative content itself. All metrics are calibrated [0,1] unless noted; sentiments are [-1,1]. grounding_status flags whether each block is observed vs estimated. UPPER_SNAKE node_id is stable and is the target of every typed link handle.

node_id.description: Stable id, UPPER_SNAKE, prefix IN_ (e.g. IN_PERSON_DILJIT_DOSANJH, IN_NEWS_US_INDIA_H1B_2025). Immutable; target of every typed link handle.

ingested_at.description: UTC ingest timestamp; reactions are valid as-of this time.

item_type.description: Coarse kind of the ingested item; drives which optional blocks are expected.

provenance.description: Where this understanding came from; every downstream factual claim must be traceable here.

source_urls.description: Canonical public URLs ingested from (article, post, profile, track, image host).

mirror_urls.description: Secondary/archive copies (e.g. web.archive.org) for link-rot resilience.

collection_method.description: How the bytes were obtained; SCRAPE implies higher ToS scrutiny.

license_or_rights.description: Stated license/copyright/right-holder note, or 'unknown'. Constrains downstream reuse.

is_public_information.description: True only if lawfully public. Gates the whole pipeline; private/leaked material is false and excluded from GENERATE.

confidence.description: Confidence the provenance attribution itself is correct.

item.description: WHAT the item is, on its own terms.

aka.description: Aliases, stage names, transliterations, alternate spellings.

what_it_is.description: One-sentence plain statement of the thing (e.g. 'Punjabi singer-actor','wire report on H-1B rule change').

language.description: BCP-47-ish language tags relevant to the item (pa, hi, en).

time_anchor.description: When the item is anchored to (release/event/news date); ISO date or fuzzy ('mid-2025').

media_refs.description: URLs to the actual media referenced, NOT copies stored by us.

factual_claims.description: Atomized claims with verifiability tags. ALLEGED/RUMOR must NOT be stated as fact downstream (false-light/defamation guard).

behind.description: WHO/WHAT is behind the item -- agency, ownership, intent; distinguishes subject from producer.

who_or_what.description: Person/org/collective responsible for or central to the item.

entity_kind.description: AUTOMATED/ANONYMOUS raises bot/astroturf prior for any reaction it drives.

is_real_identifiable_person.description: TRUE triggers the full safety_register (likeness, voice, right-of-publicity, defamation).

public_figure_status.description: MINOR_OR_PROTECTED hard-blocks GENERATE; drives publicity/defamation thresholds.

affiliations.description: Labels, parties, teams, employers, networks -- used for geo/topic relevance and conflict checks.

controls_handles.description: Official/verified handles this entity controls, to separate the entity's own voice from reaction.

place.description: Place/region anchoring for MAP expansion and geo-relevance linking.

primary_region.description: Most relevant region (e.g. 'Punjab, IN','USA','Mumbai'); should match a geo_key in links.

region_hierarchy.description: Decreasing-size path for MAP traversal: ['IN','Punjab','Amritsar'] or ['US','CA','LA'].

diaspora_relevance.description: Cross-border salient communities (e.g. 'Punjabi diaspora US/CA/UK'). Enables cross-region links like US-India immigration -> Punjab.

geo_market_tier.description: Coarse market size for the decreasing-hype MAP traversal.

known_for.description: What the entity/item is KNOWN FOR -- the salience hook used when linking.

primary.description: Single strongest association (e.g. 'Coachella 2023 Punjabi set','the visa-backlog story').

interest_domain.description: Top-level niche for the MAP interest-split (music->genre, sport->cricket).

interest_subgenre.description: Niche split values (e.g. ['Punjabi pop','bhangra'] or ['cricket','IPL']); top-5-per-niche selection runs over these at MAP stage.

iconic_assets.description: Recognizable motifs (catchphrase, signature look, hook line) usable as scene hooks WITHOUT reproducing protected media.

audience.description: Who pays attention; feeds target-audience selection for GENERATE.

core_demo.description: Primary audience descriptor (e.g. 'Punjabi youth 16-30, India + diaspora').

age_bands.description: Presence of U13/13_17 raises minor-protection constraints on the eventual content.

platform_mix.description: Where this audience lives, [0,1] share each.

size_estimate.description: Rough reachable audience count; omit if unknown.

sentiment_baseline.description: Pre-existing audience disposition toward the entity, -1 hostile .. +1 adoring.

signal.description: Cross-platform reaction reading across news, Reddit, X, Instagram, YouTube. The 'are the comments real?' block lives here.

sentiment.description: Mean reaction polarity on that platform.

sample_size.description: N comments/posts sampled for this read.

per_platform.description: One entry per platform actually sampled. Absent platform = not read (distinct from read-and-empty).

consensus_vs_division.description: 0 = platforms agree, 1 = platforms sharply disagree with each other.

authenticity.description: Is the reaction real? Higher bot_astroturf_risk must DISCOUNT hype and is logged as a reason.

organic_score.description: 1 = looks fully organic, 0 = looks fully manufactured.

bot_astroturf_risk.description: Probability the visible reaction is inflated by bots/coordinated/astroturf.

verified_share.description: Fraction of reaction from established/verified accounts.

hype.description: Is this GENUINELY hyped, and is it the medium-tier opportunity (KEY INSIGHT) rather than the over-saturated global top?

raw_hype.description: Surface attention level before authenticity discount.

authenticity_adjusted_hype.description: raw_hype discounted by bot_astroturf_risk and over-saturation; the number MAP/LINK ranks on.

tier.description: MEDIUM_OPPORTUNITY is the target band; OVER_SATURATED is explicitly de-prioritized.

opportunity_score.description: Composite rewarding medium-tier+organic+linkable, penalizing over-saturated+astroturfed. Primary MAP ranking key.

evidence.description: Why this hype reading (trend points, search interest, volume deltas).

critical_read.description: Short adversarial read: criticize the news/item, surface what the hype hides.

summary.description: 1-3 sentence skeptical take (spin, missing context, manufactured angle).

credibility.description: How much to trust the item's own claims.

sensitivity_flags.description: Topical sensitivities that constrain joke/association framing in GENERATE.

links.description: Typed, linkable handles that let 2-3 nodes combine into one scene; the LINK stage joins on these.

type.description: Typed namespace so joins are unambiguous (PLACE:punjab links to PLACE:punjab, not TOPIC:punjab).

value.description: Normalized tag value, lowercase_snake preferred for join stability.

weight.description: Centrality of this tag to the node; drives best-scene selection.

typed_tags.description: The combinable handles. A strong scene = 2-3 nodes sharing high-weight compatible tags.

geo_keys.description: Normalized geo-relevance keys (e.g. 'punjab','us_india_immigration','diaspora_us'). LINK stage MUST require an overlapping geo_key before joining a regional person to a news item (e.g. only link a Punjab person to US-India immigration news).

geo_relevance_ok.description: False forbids the join even if topically tempting (geo-relevance guard).

suggested_link_partners.description: Pre-computed candidate joins to other nodes by id; advisory for the LINK stage.

machine_summary.description: LOSSLESS, token-efficient, information-dense, machine-facing summary. A downstream agent can reconstruct the node's decision-relevant state from this field ALONE.

dense.description: Single packed line in a fixed pipe/KV grammar. Recommended slots: id|type|name|behind(realperson?)|place>region_path|known_for|interest:domain/subgenre|aud:demo@platforms|sent:agg(+per-platform)|auth:organic/botrisk|hype:adjtier/opp|crit:onelineskeptic|safety:flags|tags:type:value;...|geo:keys. Abbreviations MUST be expandable from schema_hint. Lossless = decision-lossless: no field that changes a downstream decision may be dropped.

schema_hint.description: Grammar/abbreviation key needed to losslessly parse `dense` (e.g. 'sent=[-1,1]; botrisk=[0,1]; tier in {UNDERGROUND..OVER_SATURATED}'). Makes the dense line self-describing.

token_estimate.description: Approx token cost of `dense`; budget guard for GENERATE prompt assembly.

lossless_assertion.description: Producer asserts every decision-relevant field is recoverable from `dense`+`schema_hint`; validator may spot-check.

safety_flags.description: Per-node safety state. GENERATE reads this gate FIRST and must honor safety_register.

involves_voice_or_likeness.description: True if downstream could clone voice or reproduce likeness.

generate_allowed.description: Decision gate for GENERATE. BLOCK/HUMAN_REVIEW stop or escalate before any derivative content.

applicable_constraints.description: Ids from safety_register that apply to this node (e.g. ['SR_LIKENESS','SR_SYN_DISCLOSE']).

grounding_status.description: Per-block observed-vs-estimated flags (mirrors the reference KB's source_grounding_status) so downstream knows evidence vs heuristic.

signal_grounded.description: True only if per_platform reads are from actual sampled comments, not guessed.

stale_after.description: Reaction/hype reads should be re-pulled after this time.
